ValidationRule.description: A sellable product must be billable and taxable on day one. Bundle parents carry no charge of their own.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( IsActive, OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Billing_Model__c)), AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(Billing_Model__c, "Bundle")), ISBLANK(Tax_Code__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Active products need a Billing Model and, unless they are a bundle, a Tax Code from the Tax team.
